engineering_architecture.decision: Assistant-supplied closeout design: no capstone feature expansion. Read existing evidence gates and accepted local checks first; hash exact portfolio bytes against the checked-out 40-hex source commit; assess certification evidence against the rechecked official guide. Classify missing evidence as carryover, never as success. The learner implements/tests the offline receipt and readiness seams. This produces neither learner completion, an AWS exam pass, production/customer ownership, nor Staff/Principal/FDE readiness.

Return only not_ready or a separate booking-review recommendation; never pass/book.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Actual assessment rows, independent ratios, missing/malformed/stale-guide/duplicate/under-threshold controls, no exam_passed/booking_authorized claims.
